lines.text: I was just reading the request notes, {laugh} and somebody asked for the same song three times in a row.
It has been a long day for everybody, {sigh} so here is something gentle to carry you home.
Let me take a quick moment {breath} and then we will dive right into the next set of songs.
So the next song is, {um} let me check my notes, one of the best from this year.
